transcript_snippet: PRODUCER: 'Mr. Davis, before I email the official proposal link over, I want to walk you through the three coverage options we put together across Travelers, Safeco, and Progressive. For your home and two vehicles, Travelers came out on top with three huge advantages: first, full replacement cost on your roof; second, $500k liability to protect your assets; and third, the multi-policy bundle saves you $340 annually. Compared to your current state minimums, this gives you ten times the coverage for only $12 more per month. If this looks good to you, we can lock this in on monthly EFT and get your binder generated today.'
